fact_check_verdict: Publish only as a proposed study and a live public-process story. FERC accepted the preliminary-permit application for filing and opened comment. It has not issued the permit, approved construction, validated engineering, found feasibility, or completed environmental review.

claims.spoken: On September fourth, F E R C published notice of Deep Green's preliminary-permit application.
requires: Acceptance for filing is not permit issuance or construction approval.

claims.spoken: Deep Green proposes sixty-six subsea compute hives.
requires: Call them compute or data-center pods. AI is only the applicant's characterization.

claims.spoken: The same concept proposes about three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty marine hydrokinetic turbines.
The hives would take power directly and use passive subsea cooling.
requires: Design feature only. No performance, efficiency, cost, freshwater or reliability claim.

claims.spoken: A roughly three point five mile hybrid cable would carry power and fiber to Nikiski.
requires: Proposed 115 kV cable and landing, not built infrastructure.

claims.spoken: The notice gives a one hundred megawatt estimate.
requires: Never call this annual generation or convert to MWh. It is a proposal estimate, not demonstrated output.

claims.spoken: The data center would be the primary use of that power.
requires: Do not imply 100 MW is promised to the Railbelt.

claims.spoken: The notice says spare electricity could be diverted to the Railbelt through a proposed substation.
requires: Could, not will. No interconnection agreement or utility commitment is established.

claims.spoken: The filing names no customer or committed financing.
claims.on_screen: NO CUSTOMER OR COMMITTED FINANCING NAMED
requires: Absence is limited to the filing materials reviewed.

claims.spoken: Comments and competing applications are due November second at one P M Alaska time.
claims.on_screen: PUBLIC RECORD CLOSES · NOVEMBER 2ND · 1 PM AK
requires: Source deadline is 5 PM Eastern, converted to 1 PM Alaska Standard Time.

claims.spoken: A preliminary permit, if issued, gives priority to study feasibility.
requires: No land-disturbing work or entry without permission. No construction or operating authority.

claims.spoken: The record contains no completed study of output, cooling, economics, grid connection, or environmental effects.
requires: No claim that the concept fails. No claim that environmental harm is established.

claims.spoken: The proposed site is the East Foreland Corridor in Upper Cook Inlet near Nikiski.
requires: Do not imply land or water access has been granted.

claims.spoken: Brief comments can be filed without prior registration.
requires: Brief comments are limited to 10,000 characters and remain subject to the notice instructions.
